settings.model: ordered logit, M0c vs M1 nested likelihood-ratio test (severity.fit_ordered_logit, severity.nested_lr_test)

calibration.weights: flagged narratives 1 (certainty stratum); other validation narratives 1 / inclusion probability
calibration.other_rows_get: mean of the five fold maps

settings.ame_definition: discrete change from 0 to 1 averaged over riders, for binary labels and plug-in probabilities alike

notes.fusion_note: the fused hard label keeps Route B wherever the routes disagree, so as a label source it equals the reference run; it is not estimated as a separate variant
notes.calibration_not_stored_upstream: no isotonic calibration exists in src before this script; the calibrated probabilities and their out-of-fold diagnostics are built and saved here for the first time
notes.draw_independence: labels are drawn independently across cues given their probabilities; co-occurrence between cues in the automated rows is not preserved
notes.attenuation: draws from the calibrated probability alone ignore severity, so they attenuate any cue-severity association in the automated rows toward zero, which favours the null; the outcome-informed draws are the check on that
notes.plugin_cv_note: calibrated plug-in values for the automated rows use maps fitted on the human rows only, so the outcome never enters the calibration; the cross-validated log loss treats them as fixed covariates

i_final_labels_primary.description: final labels: human majority on 187 riders, Route B reference run on 335

ii_llm_reference_labels.description: Route B reference run (temperature 0) on every rider, no human labels

ii_b_vote_share_majority_labels.description: hard label when more than half of the five temperature-0.7 runs are positive, every rider

iii_plugin_calibrated_hybrid.description: calibrated probability on the 335 automated riders, human label on the 187

iii_b_plugin_calibrated_all_rows.description: calibrated probability on every rider (out-of-fold on the human-coded ones)

iii_c_plugin_raw_vote_share.description: uncalibrated five-run vote share on every rider

iv_draws_calibrated.description: 50 Bernoulli draws from the calibrated probability for the 335 automated riders, human labels kept on the 187; M1 refitted per draw and pooled by Rubin's rules

cue_block_test_D2_combined_lr.note: a negative D2 is truncated at zero for the p-value

iv_draws_calibrated.cross_validation: not run: 50 refits per draw would cost 2,500 fits; the pooled block test answers the question the draws exist for

iv_b_draws_outcome_informed.description: 50 draws for the automated riders from a logistic imputation model of the human label on logit(calibrated p) and severity class, parameters drawn from their Laplace posterior each time; human labels kept on the 187

cue_block_test_D2_combined_lr.note: a negative D2 is truncated at zero for the p-value

iv_b_draws_outcome_informed.cross_validation: not run: 50 refits per draw would cost 2,500 fits; the pooled block test answers the question the draws exist for

v_human_subset_reduced.rule: binary covariates and cues enter only with at least 5 events in every severity class of the subset; continuous covariates are kept. Fixed before estimation.

prevalence.unit: share of rider rows (n = 522 unless stated); plug-in rows are mean probabilities
